name: Slack
diffReason: Moderate: other workspaces can install without review, but apps outside the Slack Marketplace get lower rate limits on some methods

steps.d: api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From scratch. Give it a name and pick a development workspace.
OAuth & Permissions → add an HTTPS redirect URL with no #, and only the bot scopes you use. PKCE is optional.
Manage Distribution → complete the checklist → Activate Public Distribution. Other workspaces can then install it without a review.
Only needed to be listed. The app must be installed on 10 or more active workspaces first.

blockers.s: Since May 29, 2025, new apps outside the Marketplace are limited to 1 request a minute and 15 objects on conversations.history and conversations.replies.
Slack's published estimate: up to 10 business days for the preliminary review, then up to 10 weeks for the functional review of a new submission.

agent: Pick minimum scopes for your use case
you: Create the app in your workspace
sources: Rate limit changes for non-Marketplace apps
